f05d1524424f5ec5484b5d0858fee86919307ec0.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence report (published 2024-05-28) on Moonstone Sleet, a threat actor Microsoft assesses is North Korean state-aligned and formerly tracked as Storm-1789. It links the actor to Diamond Sleet and describes fake companies and job lures, trojanized PuTTY loaders (SplitLoader, YouieLoad), a malicious tank game called DeTankWar, malicious npm packages, and the FakePenny ransomware, which demanded $6.6M USD in BTC. Targets named include software, education and defense industrial base organisations. Microsoft assesses the actor's aims as espionage and revenue generation.

f0487f5496a4edf0b00f792aab65d938674ca196.summary: Unit 42 (Palo Alto Networks) describes activity cluster CL-STA-0046, which attacked a Southeast Asian government over more than six months in 2022-2023. Unit 42 attributes the cluster to the Gelsemium APT group with moderate confidence, citing the rare backdoors OwlProxy and SessionManager. Other tools seen include web shells, Cobalt Strike, EarthWorm and SpoolFool. Telsy and the Thai CERT link Gelsemium to China; Unit 42 cannot confirm that.
